title: SQANTI-evidence: structural genome annotation from long-read RNA-seq

creators.name: Atienza, Pablo
creators.affiliation: Institute for Integrative Systems Biology (I2SysBio), CSIC-UV, Valencia, Spain

creators.name: Conesa, Ana
creators.affiliation: Institute for Integrative Systems Biology (I2SysBio), CSIC-UV, Valencia, Spain

description: Snakemake workflow that builds a structural genome annotation from a genome assembly and long-read RNA-seq (PacBio Iso-Seq/HiFi or Oxford Nanopore). IsoQuant transcript models curated with SQANTI3 form Tier 1 of the annotation; Augustus trained on the species' own dominant ORFs and BUSCO orthologs, guided by hints from the curated transcripts and Miniprot self-protein alignments, fills the unexpressed loci (Tier 2).
